page: Amazon Web Services i7i.metal-24xl is a bare-metal, storage-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8559C processor running at a base clock speed of 3.2 GHz across 48 physical cores and 96 vCPUs, backed by a large 320 MB L3 cache. Memory configuration includes 768 GB of high-speed DDR5 RAM operating at 6 GHz, yielding an 8 GB per vCPU ratio. Direct bare-metal access eliminates hypervisor overhead, exposing hardware extensions such as Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 vector instructions alongside 56 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth.

A central component of this platform is its integrated local storage array, providing 22,500 GB (22.5 TB) of direct-attached NVMe SSD capacity. The instance lacks dedicated GPU hardware, directing all computational tasks through its high-density CPU and memory subsystem. In benchmark evaluations, the server achieves top-tier results in multi-core metrics, including a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 553.21 GB/sec, a PassMark database score of 33,628.93, and static web serving throughput reaching 136.82 GB/sec. Memory read bandwidth registers at 289.55 GB/sec on large uncached blocks.

Cost efficiency is driven by the extreme density of local flash storage and high-throughput compute paired on a single dedicated socket system, eliminating separate networked storage costs for I/O-intensive workloads. However, the architecture represents a clear tradeoff: the lack of discrete GPU acceleration restricts deep learning training performance, while the fixed allocation of bare-metal resources requires consistent load to prevent underutilization. The server is ideally matched for high-throughput distributed databases, transactional storage systems, massive in-memory caching nodes, large-scale software compilation, and data analytics pipelines.

Lacking discrete GPUs, it relies on hardware features like AMX and AVX-512 to drive computational workloads. Delivering substantial localized throughput without hypervisor penalties, i7i.metal-24xl is designed for high-demand relational databases, real-time analytics, distributed file storage, and data-intensive batch workloads.
